messages.content: Your last question was "what is an ai agent?"
can you provide an answer to my last question?

Certainly! An AI agent is a software entity that uses artificial intelligence techniques to perform tasks or make decisions autonomously or semi-autonomously. AI agents can perceive their environment through sensors, process information, and take actions to achieve specific goals. They can be simple, like a chatbot that responds to user queries, or complex, like autonomous vehicles that navigate and make driving decisions in real-time. AI agents often utilize machine learning, natural language processing, and other AI methodologies to improve their performance over time.
